title: Штраф за перерыв  (Fined for the Break)

segments.t: Eleonora storms into the kitchen furious that she was kept waiting in her own restaurant while the cooks drank coffee. She fines the entire staff a day's pay, and then greets philanthropist Alyokhin, who wants to nap before discussing the loan.
Конечно, сначала спокойно отдохните в номере.
А потом мы обо всём поговорим.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'A captain must always be fair.' The meaning hinges on 'captain' working together with 'fair' in spoken Russian.
'Who decided this in here just now?' In Russian, the idea of 'who' flows naturally into 'to decide' without extra filler words.
'Am I supposed to sit and wait?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'to wait'.
'By law, cooks are entitled to a rest.' Notice how Russian expresses 'according to' and 'rest' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'For this rest everyone is fined.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'for' before landing on 'fined'.
'I am docking all of you a day's salary.' Eleonora brings out the contrast between 'I deprive' and 'everyone' in a few short words.
'Captain, take this, this is for you now.' In Russian, the idea of 'captain' flows naturally into 'you' without extra filler words.
'Right now this is simply necessary for you.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'now' and finishing on 'necessary'. Eleonora answers right away.
'Dear friend, well, how was your flight?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'expensive' and finishing on 'flew'.
Конечно, сначала спокойно отдохните в номере.
'Of course, first rest quietly in the room.' In Russian, the idea of 'of course' flows naturally into 'number' without extra filler words.
А потом мы обо всём поговорим.
'And later we will talk about everything.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'and' and finishing on 'talk'.

'I still have to ask you for money.' In Russian, the idea of 'to me' flows naturally into 'to ask' without extra filler words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Конечно, сначала спокойно отдохните в номере.
А потом мы обо всём поговорим.
While Alyokhin goes upstairs to sleep off his long flight from Australia, Mikhail's pony breaks loose in the hotel. Until next time!
